name: Chrome UX Report (CrUX)
summary: Core Web Vitals from real Chrome users for any origin or popular URL: LCP, INP, CLS, FCP and TTFB distributions and 75th percentiles, as the latest 28 days or a weekly history of up to 40 periods.

api_key.description: a Google Cloud API key from a project with the Chrome UX Report API enabled (Google Cloud console > APIs & Services > Credentials); the API is free

notes: Both calls are POSTs that only read data.
Pass origin or url, never both. Only origins and URLs with enough Chrome traffic have a record; others have none.
Units follow the metric: LCP, INP, FCP and TTFB in milliseconds; CLS is unitless and its p75 comes back as a string ('0.05').
Quota: 150 queries per minute per Google Cloud project, shared by both calls, free and not raisable.
Every record is a 28-day rolling window ending about two days before the update; dates are Pacific Standard Time.

endpoints.name: Get the latest Core Web Vitals for an origin or URL
endpoints.summary: Histograms and p75 for each metric over the latest 28 days, optionally for one form factor.

origin.description: An origin, aggregating all its pages: scheme and host, no path. Give this or url.

url.description: One page's URL. Give this or origin.

formFactor.description: Limit to one device class; omitted means all combined (and adds the form_factors split).

metrics.description: Metric names; all available when omitted. E.g. largest_contentful_paint, interaction_to_next_paint, cumulative_layout_shift, first_contentful_paint, experimental_time_to_first_byte, navigation_types, round_trip_time, form_factors.

notes: A POST that only reads data.
Updated daily around 04:00 UTC, best effort; calls the same day return the same record.

endpoints.name: Get the weekly Core Web Vitals history for an origin or URL
endpoints.summary: Weekly timeseries of each metric's histogram densities and p75, one value per 28-day collection period.

origin.description: An origin, aggregating all its pages. Give this or url.

url.description: One page's URL. Give this or origin.

formFactor.description: Limit to one device class; omitted means all combined.

metrics.description: Metric names, as for the latest record; all available when omitted.

collectionPeriodCount.description: How many weekly periods, 1 to 40. 25 when omitted.

notes: A POST that only reads data.
collectionPeriods lists the periods oldest first, and every timeseries array lines up with it by index. A period without enough data holds 'NaN' in densities and fractions and null in p75s.
Updated weekly on Mondays around 04:00 UTC with data through the previous Saturday.
